confirmed_findings.problem: After closing cloud_apply_ready, the driver invokes synchronous production _apply_profile without yielding or confirming that the host breakpoint command has been processed. Existing host ordering constructs the controller after publishing driver-ready, then sends the breakpoint. The real writer-complete/mark_dirty callback can occur before the host breakpoint is armed.
confirmed_findings.consequence: Sequence==1 can fail because the required callback was missed. Successful chain/API lookup does not establish observability or a usable actual callback driver.
confirmed_findings.minimum_successor_requirement: Before invoking real apply, require an explicit QA-only observer dispatcher arm acknowledgment received on the same debugger connection after the host breakpoint command. Preserve production apply and the source-only qualification boundary.
